panel.label: New ticket with the assistant
panel.title: New ticket
panel.subtitle: The assistant knows the tree and remembers earlier conversations

conversation.hint: Describe the task. The assistant asks what is missing, writes the ticket and looks for its place in the tree.

draft.heading: Draft
draft.title: Title
draft.searching: Looking for the place… the first search in a project can take a while.
draft.notReady: The AI still has a question before looking for the place.

quote.label: Original request
quote.hint: It is saved at the start of the ticket. Read only.

idea.label: Register as an idea
idea.hint: It enters as an idea in the “New” stage, with the parts inside it.

warning.unknownKeys: The draft mentions tickets that do not exist: {{keys}}. Fix the keys to create.
warning.tooLong: The parent ticket's description went over the limit together with the original request. Shorten the description to create.

message.label: Message to the assistant
message.placeholder: Describe the task or reply to the assistant
message.over: The message is over {{max}} characters ({{length}}). Shorten it to send.

pick.otherProject: This conversation is about project {{name}}. Click a ticket or the project itself.
pick.instruction: Click a ticket or the project on the map. Esc cancels.

path.heading: Path, from top to bottom
path.entersHere: Goes here, as a child of the previous step.
path.uncertain: I'm not sure about the place: more than one ticket fits. Choose one of the options below, go up a level or use “Choose on the map”.
path.outOfScope: This ticket may not fit in “{{title}}”.

stopped.candidates_too_large: The search stopped at “{{where}}” because there were too many tickets to compare at once. Check whether the place works or choose another.
stopped.max_levels: The search stopped at “{{where}}” on reaching the level limit. Check whether the place works or choose another.

path.ideaNote: It enters as an idea in the “New” stage, outside the process, until someone accepts it.
path.partsNote_one: {{count}} part is created inside the ticket.
path.partsNote_other: The {{count}} parts are created inside the ticket, in the order of the draft.

proposal.line: This ticket seems to form a group with others here.
proposal.list: Tickets that go to the new parent ticket
